## Context / Problem
The removal story (granitic-realisable-dolphin) landed as `2de5f341ec4` (Gerrit 3046); it already dropped the `docs/exit-codes.md` `enrich` row, the `docs/README.md` calibration link, the `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` `enrich_drain*` glob, and the `_proc.py`/`compact_trigger.py:25` docstrings. The prose still describes the removed detector: `docs/adr/0086-cross-ticket-overlap.md:5` reads `**Status:** Accepted` and `:67-68` claims `verify.overlap_enabled` "remains a permanent alias" (false since ADR 0116; `src/rebar/_config_sections.py` `_ALIASES = {}`); `docs/event-schema.md:71-72` names deleted producer modules; `docs/config.md:157-171` describes the store-wide detector; `docs/llm-framework.md:460-483` documents the drain; kept modules carry comments citing the deleted overlap/enrich code. The breaking change needs its release-notes entry. Cites re-verified on origin/main 2de5f341ec4.

## Approach
One prose-only change: rewrite the ADR status and note, the four event-type rows, and the config key text; delete the drain section; add the BREAKING release note and append to the existing CHANGELOG `### Removed`; sweep the stale comments. No behavior change and no generated file. Every ADR uses `**Status:** <word>`; `docs/adr/README.md` is generated by slug, not status (`scripts/gen_adr_index.py`), so no index regen.

## Scope
- `docs/adr/0086-cross-ticket-overlap.md:5` -> `**Status:** Retired 2026-09-06 — implementation removed in 2de5f341ec4 (originally Accepted, epic only-crave-art); redesign tracked on epic fattish-plucky-bufflehead (62dc-535b-5d05-421d)`. After `:3` insert a `>` note: the `enrich` verb, write-path drain, certification-time `ENQUEUE_ENRICH` producer, BM25F retrieve plus pairwise judge and `[llm] overlap_*` tunables were removed; the four event names stay recognized so historical stores parse; retired because each drained ticket pushed about 4 commits to the shared `tickets` branch, starving other writers (rebar-ticket 62ab-c11e-30c2-40be); the file remains as the historical design record. `:67-68` "the old key remains a permanent alias" -> "the old spelling was retired by ADR 0116 and no longer resolves".
- `docs/event-schema.md:71` -> `| \`TICKET_DIGEST\` | retired producer (ADR 0086) | No maintained producer or consumer; the name is kept in \`_NON_REPLAY_KNOWN_TYPES\` and the store allowlist so historical events still parse; compaction preserves the files. |`; `:72` stays ONE combined row for `ENQUEUE_ENRICH` / `CLAIM_ENRICH` / `DONE_ENRICH` with the same wording (two rows carry the phrase in total).
- `docs/config.md:156` key comment becomes `# ADVISORY create-time duplicate journal ONLY:` followed by the surviving `:172-179` text; delete `:157-171` (the schema default stays `false`). `:215` and `docs/concurrency.md:459` drop "mirroring the enrichment drain"; `docs/config.md:431`, `docs/architecture.md:107`, `docs/reuse-surface.md:627` drop `enrich` and the `overlap/*` workers; `docs/reuse-surface.md:235`, `docs/llm-framework.md:810` drop the `overlap/judge.py` example; `docs/llm-framework.md:257,259` drop the judge/enrichment class uses, `:286-299` drop the `rebar.llm.enrich` command and say the recorded end-to-end run used that since-removed op, `:460-483` delete, `:521` drop "an enrich pass", `:770` drop `**/enrich_drain*`.
- `docs/release-notes.md`: before `:11` add `## BREAKING (pre-1.0) — the cross-ticket overlap/enrichment implementation (ADR 0086) is removed`: `rebar enrich` is an unknown subcommand; the 13 `[llm]` keys `overlap_propositions_min`, `overlap_propositions_max`, `overlap_k`, `overlap_max_doc_freq`, `overlap_min_should_match`, `overlap_soak_min`, `overlap_lease_ttl_min`, `overlap_reenrich_debounce_min`, `overlap_conf_threshold`, `overlap_surface_cap`, `overlap_drain`, `overlap_drain_batch`, `overlap_drain_gate_budget_ms` and their `REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_*` env vars are removed with no tombstone (ADR 0116); a leftover `[llm] overlap_*` key is silently ignored because `[llm]` is reserved, so delete it; `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets` now gates only the create-time journal; `review-plan`/MCP verdicts carry no `overlap` key and `show` no `digest_freshness`; `doctor` reports five lock legs; `rebar.llm.enrich` and the `ticket_digest`/`overlap_verdict` contracts and schemas are gone. Migration: delete the keys; remove `.rebar/enrich-drain.lock`, `.rebar/logs/enrich-drain.log`, `.rebar/enrich-gate.json`; historical events need no action.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: append to the existing `## [Unreleased]` / `### Removed` a two-line entry pointing at the release note.
- Comment-only rewording: `src/rebar/_commands/compact_trigger.py:44`, `_commands/recent_creates.py:123`, `_store/lock_owner.py:309`, `_store/stamped_lock.py:60,70`, `llm/pai_retry.py:36,209`, `llm/step_failures.py:4-7`, `llm/structured.py:114-117`, `llm/usage_log.py:94,571`, `llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py:154`, `llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py:535`, `llm/epic_bug_screen.py:233`; test docstrings `tests/unit/test_context_hints_single_source.py:11`, `tests/unit/test_first_request_window_f79d.py:13,78`.
- Leave untouched (other senses or history): Jira-reconciler "enrichment", `docs/experiments/**`, `docs/adr/0116-retire-config-aliases.md`, older release-note/CHANGELOG entries, `_snapshot/gc_trigger.py` ("overlap" = concurrent passes), and the `overlap-judge` example in three verdict schemas (editing forces a `types.py` regen for prose).

## Testing
Docs and comments only. `make verify` plus the docs gates below; `pytest tests/interfaces/contracts/test_event_schema_relations.py -q` green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `git grep -nE 'enrich_drain|llm\.overlap|overlap/\*|overlap_drain|REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP|digest_sidecar|ENQUEUE_ENRICH producer' -- docs/*.md docs/adr/0086-cross-ticket-overlap.md src .rebar AGENTS.md README.md CONTRIBUTING.md ':!docs/release-notes.md' ':!docs/experiments' ':!docs/adr/0116*' ':!CHANGELOG.md'` prints nothing.
- [ ] `sed -n '5p' docs/adr/0086-cross-ticket-overlap.md` starts with `**Status:** Retired 2026-09-06`; `grep -c 'permanent alias' docs/adr/0086-cross-ticket-overlap.md` prints `0`.
- [ ] `grep -nE '^## BREAKING \(pre-1.0\) — the cross-ticket overlap' docs/release-notes.md` matches the first `##` heading, and `sed -n '/^## BREAKING (pre-1.0) — the cross-ticket overlap/,/^## BREAKING (pre-1.0) — visual/p' docs/release-notes.md | grep -oE 'overlap_[a-z_]+' | grep -vx overlap_verdict | sort -u | wc -l` prints `13` (the section also names the `overlap_verdict` contract).
- [ ] `grep -c 'retired producer (ADR 0086)' docs/event-schema.md` prints `2`.
- [ ] `python scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check && python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check && python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry validate-routing` exits 0.
- [ ] Local `make verify` fails only on the 17 pandoc host-defect tests (frenzied-snively-llama); the change reaches `Verified +1`.
